title.narrative: Accelerating energy efficiency in larger industries through energy management systems, system optimization and the promotion and adoption of energy efficiency in small and medium-sized enterprises

description.narrative: Accelerating energy efficiency in larger industries through energy management systems, system optimization and the promotion and adoption of energy efficiency in small and medium-sized enterprises. Project is part of the #EU-Vietnam Sustainable Energy Transition Programme (SETP)# in which UNIDO is responsible for the work on Energy Efficiency.
